proposed_statement_changes.proposed: Let \(H\) be symmetric and satisfy \(H_{ii}=0\) whenever no \(z\in Z\) has \(i\in O_z\), as well as the published Harshaw--Middleton--Savje pairwise design-compatibility criterion \(H_{ik}=0\) whenever \(i\ne k\) and no \(z\in Z\) has \(\{i,k\}\subseteq O_z\). Then \(h_H\in\mathcal E_{\mathcal J,2}\subseteq\mathcal E_{\mathcal J,3}\). If also \(H-A\succeq0\), then \(h_H\in\mathcal C_{\mathcal J}(f)\cap\mathcal E_{\mathcal J,2}\). The inclusion of published Harshaw--Middleton--Savje conservative quadratic candidates satisfying these observability conditions in the Boolean quadratic cone is strict: the constant function with value \(1+\max_{\theta\in\Theta}f(\theta)\) belongs to \(\mathcal C_{\mathcal J}(f)\cap\mathcal E_{\mathcal J,2}\) but cannot equal any \(h_H\), since every homogeneous quadratic satisfies \(h_H(0)=0\). Consequently the inclusion in the Boolean quadratic/cubic comparison cone is also strict.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The frozen off-diagonal condition alone does not control an unobservable diagonal. In the smallest counterexample, take \(K=1\), one positive-probability assignment with \(O_z=\varnothing\), and \(H=[1]\). The stated distinct-pair condition is vacuous, but \(h_H(\theta)=\theta_0\notin\mathcal E_{\mathcal J}\), which contains only constants. Requiring a zero diagonal exactly for never-observed coordinates is the minimal missing observability condition; it is vacuous in the six-coordinate witness, where every singleton is observed.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Construct an explicit nontrivial Paluck--Shepherd--Aronow exposure block, enumerate its unchanged assignment law and direct-effect score, and provide a lossless rational orbit/separator reduction together with lifted primal and dual certificates showing a strict higher-order improvement over every observable quadratic bound.
open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen core supplies only the abstract decomposition handle. It contains no assignment atoms, exposure-coordinate map, direct-effect coefficients, automorphism orbits, separator states, or candidate block. Without those typed finite inputs, neither losslessness nor a strict objective gap is a mathematical consequence of the core; inventing an independent block would change the published design and estimand.
open_obligations.attempted: The observable-margin reduction, automorphism quotient route, and independent-product tensorization were checked. The first two cannot be instantiated without the school-design records, and tensorization is inapplicable unless the actual randomization factors over disjoint schedule blocks.
